description: Source code implementing Android's service manager functions for managing binder services, including adding, checking, getting, registering, and notification handling.

classes.name: AServiceManager_NotificationRegistration
classes.description: Handles registration callbacks for service notifications, including managing callback invocation and cleanup.

methods.name: AServiceManager_addService
methods.description: Adds a service to the Android service manager with a specified instance name.

methods.name: AServiceManager_addServiceWithFlags
methods.description: Adds a service with additional flags, such as allowing isolated services.

methods.name: AServiceManager_checkService
methods.description: Checks for a service by name and returns a binder handle if available.

methods.name: AServiceManager_getService
methods.description: Retrieves a service by name, waiting if necessary.

methods.name: AServiceManager_registerLazyService
methods.description: Registers a service lazily with the service registrar.

methods.name: AServiceManager_waitForService
methods.description: Waits for a service to become available and returns its binder handle.

methods.name: AServiceManager_registerForServiceNotifications
methods.description: Registers for notifications when a service is registered.

methods.name: AServiceManager_NotificationRegistration
methods.description: Class for managing registration callbacks for service notifications.

methods.name: AServiceManager_NotificationRegistration_delete
methods.description: Deletes a notification registration and cleans up resources.

methods.name: AServiceManager_isDeclared
methods.description: Checks if a service instance is declared.

methods.name: AServiceManager_forEachDeclaredInstance
methods.description: Iterates over all declared instances of a given interface.

methods.name: AServiceManager_isUpdatableViaApex
methods.description: Checks if a service can be updated via APEX.

methods.name: AServiceManager_getUpdatableApexName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the updatable APEX for a service.

methods.name: AServiceManager_setActiveServicesCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback for active services.
